title: SOCKONE_Sensor_Data_Schema
description: CHRONI-SENSE LABS SOCKONE Smart Sock Multimodal Physiological & Biomechanical Data Specification

Timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of sensor recording

Heart_Rate_BPM.description: Real-time heart rate in beats per minute derived from optical PPG sensor

HRV_RMSSD.description: Root Mean Square of Successive RR interval Differences. Lower values (<20 ms) indicate sympathetic dominance and acute pain/stress distress.

Gait_Symmetry_Score.description: Bilateral kinematic symmetry percentage derived from 6-axis IMU (100% = perfect symmetry; <70% = severe antalgic limping)

Pressure_Asymmetry_Pct.description: Percentage discrepancy of ground reaction force load between left and right foot insole sensors (>20% indicates acute load avoidance)

Cadence_SPM.description: Locomotion cadence. Sharp declines indicate rapid onset of neuromuscular fatigue.

Stride_Time_Variability_Pct.description: Coefficient of variation for stride duration. Values >5% reflect gait instability and fall risk.

Peak_Heel_Pressure_kPa.description: Maximum pressure under calcaneal zone during heel strike

Peak_Forefoot_Pressure_kPa.description: Maximum pressure across metatarsal heads during push-off

Daily_Step_Count.description: Cumulative step count recorded for the day

Fatigue_Level.description: Multimodal classification of physiological and physical fatigue

Pain_Score_AI.description: Objective continuous pain index (0-10) calculated by ChroniSense Edge-AI model blending autonomic HRV suppression and antalgic biomechanical gait deviance.

Alert_Status.description: Real-time clinical triage alert flag based on threshold crossings

Recommended_Action.description: Actionable decision recommendation for clinical team or patient app
